concerns.text: T014a and T014b (Knowledge Distillation training) explicitly depend on the artifact `data/processed/subtle_cue_subset.parquet` generated by T020. However, T020 is listed in Phase 4 (US2) while T014a/b are in Phase 3 (US1). The current ordering places the consumer (training) before the producer (data loader), creating an impossible execution flow. T020 must be moved to Phase 2 (Foundational) or Phase 3 (before T014) to satisfy the producer-before-consumer rule.

T020 description states it consumes 'feature masks from T021a' to determine streaming classes. T021a is listed after T020 in the task list. A task cannot consume an artifact that has not yet been produced. T021a must precede T020.

T029 and T030 (Robustness Curve Analysis) require 'bits/params vs AUC' data. T024 is the task that generates the `robustness_metrics.csv` containing this AUC data. The dependency graph does not explicitly link T029/T030 to T024 as a prerequisite. Without T024 completing first, T029/T030 have no input data. T024 must be ordered before T029.

T039a (Re-execution of inference) depends on 'ablated models from T037/T038'. T037 and T038 are listed after T039a in the task sequence. The consumer (inference on ablated models) is placed before the producer (creation of ablated models). T037 and T038 must precede T039a.

T040 (Generate ablation results) depends on T039b (Recalculation of metrics). T039b is listed after T040. The task generating the final CSV (T040) is placed before the task calculating the metrics it needs to aggregate (T039b). T039b must precede T040.

T021b (Control Set generator) is listed after T021a but before T020. T020 depends on 'class definitions from T021/T021b'. While T021b is before T020, the dependency text 'T021/T021b' implies a combined output. Ensure T021a and T021b are grouped or T020 explicitly waits for both to avoid partial execution issues.
